metadata.name: holdfast_vault
metadata.description: Holdfast per-coin vault: creator fees fund a floor defence and holder payouts. No withdraw.

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority may create the config (prevents an init front-run).

errors.name: CreatorMismatch
errors.msg: bonding curve creator is not this coin's treasury

errors.name: InvalidOwner
errors.msg: account does not belong to the expected program

errors.name: InvalidAccountData
errors.msg: account data does not match the expected layout

errors.name: WrongPriceAccount
errors.msg: price account does not match the coin's venue

errors.name: NotCanonicalPool
errors.msg: pool is not the canonical PumpSwap pool for this mint

errors.name: ObservationTooSoon
errors.msg: price observation too soon after the previous one

errors.name: NoFloor
errors.msg: no floor yet: ATH has not been established

errors.name: FloorVaultTooSmall
errors.msg: floor vault too small to defend

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: swap returned fewer tokens than required

errors.name: OverspentSwap
errors.msg: swap spent more SOL than allowed

errors.name: RoundAlreadyOpen
errors.msg: a payout round is already open

errors.name: InvalidRoundId
errors.msg: round id must be the next one

errors.name: RoundTooSoon
errors.msg: too soon since the previous round

errors.name: PotExceedsBucket
errors.msg: round pot exceeds the holder bucket

errors.name: NotAWallet
errors.msg: recipient is not a regular wallet

errors.name: RecipientBelowRent
errors.msg: payout would leave the recipient below the rent-exempt minimum

errors.name: RemainingAccountsMismatch
errors.msg: remaining accounts do not match payout entries

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: only the pending admin can accept

fields.name: amm_pool
docs: Canonical PumpSwap pool once graduated (default key before).

fields.name: trigger_bps
docs: 1500 / 2500 / 3500. Written once in `init_coin`; no instruction updates it.

fields.name: floor_sol
docs: Bucket accounting of the treasury's lamports (see invariant 2 in docs/program.md).

fields.name: holder_tokens
docs: Bought-back tokens in the treasury token account, waiting for payout rounds.

fields.name: round_id
docs: Last opened round id (0 = none yet).

fields.name: keeper
docs: Cranks ATH updates, payout rounds and $HOLD burns.

fields.name: launcher
docs: Backend wallet allowed to register coins (`init_coin`).

fields.name: hold_mint
docs: $HOLD mint. Default key until set; immutable afterwards.

fields.name: tokens
docs: Coin tokens added to the holder pool (sent to the treasury outside buybacks).

fields.name: defend_cooldown_secs
docs: Minimum seconds between two `defend` steps of the same coin.

fields.name: max_defends_per_hour
docs: Maximum `defend` steps per coin per rolling hour window.

fields.name: defend_price_tolerance_bps
docs: How far above the floor the *effective* buyback price (fees included) may be.

fields.name: twap_window_secs
docs: TWAP window used for the ATH.

fields.name: twap_min_sample_interval_secs
docs: Minimum spacing between two price observations.

fields.name: twap_max_gap_secs
docs: Largest gap between observations inside a valid TWAP window.

fields.name: ath_confirm_secs
docs: A higher TWAP must persist this long before it becomes the new ATH (0 = immediately).

fields.name: max_burn_slippage_bps
docs: Max slippage vs. spot for the $HOLD buy in `burn_hold`.

fields.name: index
docs: Position in the published snapshot (bitmap index).

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the rent; receives it back on close.

fields.name: snapshot_hash
docs: Merkle root of the published payout snapshot (see docs/payouts.md).
